req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must return HTTP 400 when the squad_number in the path does not match the squad_number in the request body. Tests cover: (1) positive case where path and body match — should NOT return 400; (2) negative case where path and body differ — must return exactly 400; (3) boundary case where squad_number differs by exactly 1 (path=10, body=11 and path=10, body=9) to catch off-by-one mutations in the inequality check; (4) decision-table case covering both directions of mismatch (body > path and body < path); (5) equivalence partition where body squad_number is wildly different from path. The route guard is `if player_model.squad_number != squad_number: raise HTTPException(status_code=400)`, so mutations flipping != to == or changing the status code constant are targeted.

tests.name: test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body containing squad_number=10
expected: HTTP status is NOT 400 (guard condition not triggered)
Response status is 204 or any non-400 code indicating the mismatch guard passed
trace: R-PLAYER-011: mismatch guard must NOT fire when IDs match
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 400

test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected()

tests.name: test_put_mismatch_status_code_is_not_404_or_422
preconditions: Player with squad_number=3 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/3 with body containing squad_number=7
Assert status is exactly 400 and not 404 or 422
expected: HTTP status is exactly 400, not 404, not 422, not 200, not 204
trace: R-PLAYER-011: mismatch must yield 400 specifically, not any other error code

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_mismatch_status_code_is_not_404_or_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Karan",
        "lastName": "Khan",
        "dateOfBirth": "1903-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 7,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "RB",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "La Liga",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/3", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 400
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 422
    assert r.status_code != 204
    assert r.status_code != 200
